::: {#exm-absolute-value}
#### Absolute value with `if`

The absolute value
$$
\abs{x} =
\begin{cases}
-x & \text{if } x < 0, \\
x & \text{otherwise}
\end{cases}
$$
has two cases, so one `if` (@def-if-cond) is enough:

```racket
(define (absolute x)
  (if (< x 0)
      (- x)
      x))
```

`(absolute -7)` returns 7, and `(absolute 2)` returns 2.
Racket already has this function, under the name `abs`.

:::
